control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.title: loss of containment at TX-8001 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-8001 and G-8103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 July 2012 an incident occurred on TX-8001 and G-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
